title: Worker features
description: How the game's files are guarded and cached.

entities.name: Nothing of the game for the uninvited
entities.description: Every file, not only the page, is behind the sign-in and the role.
entities.behavior: Cloudflare runs the Worker before its static assets for every request on the route. The Worker asks the sign-in library whether the request comes from a player holding games:lundey, and only then fetches the file. Someone signed out is redirected to sign in and comes back to the same address; someone signed in without the role gets a short page that says the game is for invited players, suggests signing in with the address they were invited at, and links back to the games.
entities.outcome: The page, the script, the styles and the icon reach invited players only.
constraints: GET and HEAD only: the Worker takes no writes.
Nothing is remembered between requests: the login service is asked each time.
If the login service or its keys are not configured, nobody counts as signed in, so nobody gets a file.

entities.name: Files are marked private
entities.description: No shared cache may keep a file of the game.
entities.behavior: The Worker replaces the static assets' caching header on every file it serves: the page is private and checked again on every visit, and everything else is private and kept for at most an hour. The not-invited page is never stored.
entities.outcome: A cache between Cloudflare and the player never holds a copy it could hand to someone who was not invited, and a new page is seen on the next visit after a deploy.
constraints: game.js has the same name in every build, so for up to an hour after a deploy a player's own browser may run the previous script with the new page.
